events.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match (Barcelona).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Galatasaray 1, Barcelona 0. Aleksey Batrakov (Galatasaray) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Rafael Leão following a fast break.
Goal! Galatasaray 1, Barcelona 1. João Cancelo (Barcelona) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Dani Olmo.
Second Half begins Galatasaray 1, Barcelona 1.
Goal! Galatasaray 1, Barcelona 2. Fermín López (Barcelona) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Lamine Yamal following a corner.
Goal! Galatasaray 1, Barcelona 3. Anthony Gordon (Barcelona) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Lamine Yamal.
Substitution, Galatasaray. Lesley Ugochukwu replaces Mario Lemina.
Substitution, Galatasaray. Gabriel Sara replaces Aleksey Batrakov.
Substitution, Galatasaray. Leroy Sané replaces Yunus Akgün.
Substitution, Barcelona. Gabriel Jesus replaces Dani Olmo.
Substitution, Barcelona. Karim Adeyemi replaces Anthony Gordon.
Rafael Leão (Galatasaray) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Galatasaray 1, Barcelona 4. Karim Adeyemi (Barcelona) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the centre of the goal.
Substitution, Galatasaray. Roland Sallai replaces Baris Alper Yilmaz.
Substitution, Barcelona. Jules Koundé replaces Eric García.
Substitution, Barcelona. Marc Bernal replaces Pedri.
Delay in match because of an injury Lucas Torreira (Galatasaray).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Galatasaray. Renato Nhaga replaces Lucas Torreira because of an injury.
Substitution, Barcelona. Gavi replaces Fermín López.
Roland Sallai (Galatasaray) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
